description: FlexColor 4.8.13 Mac driving a Flextight X1 through one preview (init + calibration + preview + stop). Captured 2026-11-12 with tools/capture/cap3.py. Serial number anonymised.
notes: response = complete response (for responses up to 64 bytes, and for page 0x21 taken from tools/x1probe at another time); response_head = first 64 bytes only
direction: in = scanner to host, out = host to scanner
image data (READ 0x28) is not included; see preview-calibration-profile.json for white/dark levels
async = issued asynchronously by FlexColor (image reads); status not captured for these
